data.narrative:
Alpine Eagle, a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Jan-Hendrik Boelens and Timo Breuer, has raised €10.25M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private peers (UFORCE at $1.0B Seed, Singularity at $400M Series A, and NODA AI at $125M Series A), supplemented by a broader reference set of 8 private and 2 public defense-tech companies including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and public comps DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS.

The peer-median method, the only applicable triangulation approach given available data density, yields a median valuation of $400M across the three direct comparables. The peer distribution spans $125M to $1.0B, establishing a wide but sector-coherent range. This $400M median implies a post-money valuation substantially above capital deployed, reflecting Defense & Security sector risk appetite at the frontier-tech stage.

The triangulated valuation range of $340M (low) to $460M (high), centered at $400M, reflects the peer-median anchor. Key uncertainties include: technical differentiation relative to the broader competitive set, customer traction beyond fundraising stage, and regulatory pathway clarity in the Defense & Security vertical. A single-method valuation warrants caution; expansion of comparable data or introduction of revenue multiple or cost-of-capital approaches would strengthen conviction.
